data.title_en: A Door I Didn't Knock On
data.content_zh:
2026 年 7 月，我搬到了广州增城。我在那里是新人，认识的人不多，也还没有开始找工作。

然后有一天，电话响了。一家做汽车内饰的公司找到了我，说要和我聊聊。我们谈得不错，接着面试，几天后我就入职了。我没有经历漫长的求职——门在我敲之前，就自己开了。

「你们要先求他的国和他的义，这些东西都要加给你们了。」（马太福音 6:33）

这些年我一直问神：一个牧师，怎么能在生意里也服侍你？我从来没有求过皮革行业的工作，是这个行业找到了我。我相信，这就是神对我那个问题的回答。

不是我找到了这家工厂，是神把它给我的。所以我把这份工作看成我的服侍。我的办公室在工厂，不在教堂，但同一位神在两个地方都与我同在。
data.content_en:
In July 2026, I moved to Zengcheng, a district of Guangzhou. I was new there. I did not know many people, and I had not started to look for a job.

Then one day, my phone rang. A company in the auto interior industry found me. They wanted to talk with me. We had a good talk, then an interview. A few days later, I started to work there. I did not search for this job for a long time. The door opened before I even knocked.

"But seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be added to you." (Matthew 6:33)

For many years, I asked God: how can a pastor also serve You in business? I never asked God for a job in the leather industry. But this industry found me. I believe this is God's answer to my question.

I did not find this factory. God gave it to me. So I see this work as my ministry. My office is a factory, not a church. But the same God is with me in both places.
data.excerpt_zh: 2026 年 7 月我搬到增城，还没开始找工作，一家汽车内饰公司就找到了我。不是我找到了这家工厂，是神把它给我的。
data.excerpt_en: In July 2026, I moved to Zengcheng. Before I even started looking for a job, a company found me. I did not find this factory — God gave it to me.

data.title_zh: Jeff牧师的个人见证：回应上帝的呼召
data.title_en: Pastor Jeff's Personal Testimony: Responding to God's Call
data.content_zh:
在我很年轻的时候，神便将我从一条完全不寻常的道路上召引出来。我出生在一个充满了偶像崇拜与民间迷信的环境里。我的父亲曾是一名算命先生，在我的成长过程中，我亲眼见证过许多超乎人类理性、却属于黑暗权势的所谓「神迹」。然而，在大学期间，我听到了万军之耶和华对我清晰的呼召——祂要我放下一切，全职服侍祂。在人看来，放弃学业是一个极其疯狂的决定，但顺服神的火焰在我心中无法熄灭。大学毕业三年后，我正式成为了一名全职牧师。

我的家人当时并不能理解这一切。在他们眼中，我只是变成了一个去教会、结交了一群「稀奇古怪之人」的异类。为了阻拦我，他们用计将我骗回了家，并将我软禁、关押了整整一个半月。那是我第一次切身地为主承受逼迫。那段日子里，失去自由的肉体之痛固然真实，但最深沉的痛苦，是眼睁睁看着自己至亲的人仍在偶像崇拜中沉沦，被骄傲所蒙蔽。那是在我全职服侍前三年的一场旷野试炼。

作为一个完全凭着异象与热忱、没有经历过系统性神学培训的年轻牧师，我在中国面对的挑战是难以想象的。在这片土地上，很多人无法理解我的身份，社会大众总习惯把「穷牧师」当作一个底层的标签贴在我们身上，冷眼与嘲笑如影随形。但在我服侍的初期，神便赐下了特别的属灵恩赐来托住我。祂常常在梦境和祷告中，将许多陌生人过去的事情和未来即将发生的事显明给我。知识性的言语与先知性的恩赐，成了神亲自给我的凭据，让我在面对许多有学历、有能力的社会精英时，服侍变得相对容易了很多。

这些年来，尽管许多人因为各自的理由选择了离开这片土地，我也完全拥有离开这里的机会，但我却始终找不到任何离开的理由。因为每当我举目观看，这里仍有太多太多的灵魂在黑暗中哭泣，他们需要福音，需要耶稣基督舍命的救赎。我是那被差遣的，我便留在这里，与祂同工。
data.content_en:
At a very young age, God called me out of darkness into an extraordinary journey.

I was born into an environment heavily entrenched in idolatry and folk superstitions. My father was a fortune-teller, and growing up, I witnessed firsthand many supernatural occurrences that defied human reason—manifestations of dark spiritual realms. Yet, during my university years, I heard the undeniable calling of God to serve Him full-time. To the world, abandoning my academic path seemed like absolute madness. But the fire of obedience could not be quenched. Three years after university, I stepped into full-time pastoral ministry.

My family, completely blind to the truth, could not comprehend this. In their eyes, I had simply become a fanatic who went to church and associated with "eccentric" people. In an attempt to stop me, they tricked me into coming home and locked me away for nearly a month and a half. That was the first time I tasted persecution for Christ. The loss of physical freedom was painful, but the deepest agony was watching my own flesh and blood remain blinded by pride, trapped in the chains of idolatry. That wilderness trial took place three years before my full-time ministry truly flourished.

As a young pastor running purely on God's calling and spiritual passion, without conventional or systematic seminary training, the challenges I faced in China were staggering. In this cultural context, many rejected my identity. Society always tends to label pastors as "poor, low-class preachers," and cold shoulders and ridicule followed me constantly. However, the Lord sustained me by pouring out distinct spiritual gifts during the early days of my ministry. In dreams and deep intercession, God would frequently reveal to me hidden matters about strangers' past lives and unfolding future events. These gifts of the Words of Knowledge and the Prophetic became God's sovereign stamp of validation upon my ministry, making it relatively much easier for me to minister to intellectual and highly capable social elites with supernatural authority.

Over the years, while many have chosen to leave this land for various reasons, and though I, too, have had every opportunity to depart, I can find absolutely no reason to leave. Whenever I look upon this fields, I see countless souls desperately weeping in the dark. They need the Gospel. They need the redeeming love of Jesus Christ. I have been sent to this harvest, and here I shall stay, co-laboring with Him.
data.excerpt_zh: 在很小的时候，上帝就呼召我离开黑暗，踏上非凡的旅程。
data.excerpt_en: At a very young age, God called me out of darkness into an extraordinary journey.
data.author: Pastor Jeff
